title: DreamCabs
description: A production-grade, multi-tenant ride-hailing and fleet management platform with real-time dispatch, integrated payments, and a unified admin dashboard.
challenge: Build a scalable ride-hailing platform that could support multiple cities, three distinct ride modes, real-time driver dispatch, integrated payments, financial operations, and role-based administration within a single ecosystem.
solution: Developed a Laravel-based REST API powering two Ionic/Angular mobile apps for customers and drivers, alongside an Angular admin dashboard with real-time WebSockets, Razorpay integration, Firebase authentication, Google Maps, dynamic pricing, and comprehensive financial management.
results: Built a Laravel REST API with 200+ endpoints
Implemented three ride modes: Private, Fixed Route, and Shuttle
Delivered two cross-platform mobile apps and a unified admin dashboard
Added real-time driver tracking and dispatch via WebSockets
Integrated Razorpay payments, driver wallets, and a complete financial ledger
Designed a multi-city architecture with role-based access control
